    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractPanelElement
    Base of MenuKit's own elements: built once by a builder, immutable after.
    AbstractPanelElement.Builder<E,B>
    The builder every MenuKit element's builder extends: the shared vocabulary, in one place, with the same names everywhere.
    Address
    One value that names any addressable thing (a vanilla slot, a created slot, a panel element or a panel itself), so the engine can resolve every behavior by address without asking what kind it is.
    AlertDialog
    Builds a modal dialog with one acknowledge button.
    AlertDialog.Builder
    Builder for an AlertDialog Panel.
    BehaviorKey<V>
    Names one behavior the window can resolve: gating, visibility, a panel's opacity, a reaction and so on.
    BehaviorKeys
    The library's built-in BehaviorKeys, one constant per behaviour.
    Button
    An interactive button within a Panel: a raised background with a centred label, an icon, or a consumer sprite as its whole face.
    Button.Builder
     
    Button.Look
    The look this frame, handed to the render hooks.
    Checkbox
    A boolean setting as a small square with a check mark and a label beside it: the settings-screen convention, and a lens onto the consumer's boolean.
    Checkbox.Builder
     
    ChildDispatch
    The one way a list of elements is rendered and receives input.
    Click
    A mouse click as seen by a PanelElement: which button, plus the modifier keys held at the moment the click was dispatched.
    ClientContainerPanel
    The client half of a ContainerPanel: what only the client has, declared from the client initializer.
    ClientMenu
    The client half of a CustomMenu: its screen class, how each of its panels looks, and the request to open it.
    ClientSlots
    The client half of CreatedSlots.onto(AbstractContainerMenu, Player): showing a registered slot group on screen.
    Column
    Lays elements out top to bottom, the vertical counterpart of Row: it positions each child with even spacing and a horizontal alignment, and returns a flat list of positioned PanelElements.
    Column.Builder
    Builds one column.
    ConfirmDialog
    Builds a modal confirm/cancel dialog.
    ConfirmDialog.Builder
    Builder for a ConfirmDialog Panel.
    ContainerKeys
    The server-tier behaviour key that Containers itself enforces.
    ContainerPanel
    Registers, in one call and with no mixin, a panel whose slots have container parity: they appear, take clicks and sync on every screen that shows the player inventory (survival, creative, and every chest, furnace or modded container).
    ContainerPanel.Builder
    Configures the panel.
    ControlStyle
    Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
    delete the style(...) call; the screen's kind decides.
    CreatedSlot
    A slot that is a vanilla Slot to everything outside it.
    CreatedSlots
    Adds real, server-synced, persistent slots to a vanilla menu.
    CreatedSlots.Builder
    Configures one group of slots.
    CreatedSlots.RegisteredSlots
    What register() created: the MenuPanel and SlotGroup, plus the slot-index range appended to the menu, for consumers that walk the slots directly.
    CrossAlign
    Cross-axis alignment for Row and Column.
    CustomAttachmentSpec<O,C>
    Implemented by consumers to extend storage attachments.
    CustomContainerMenu
    A custom container menu: its created slots, its panels as the server knows them, and whether each is shown.
    CustomContainerScreen
    Client-side partner to CustomContainerMenu: a standalone screen whose panels hold slot groups.
    CustomContainerScreen.DragMode
    A custom drag behaviour for MenuKit slots.
    CustomContainerScreen.KeyAction
    Action triggered by a key press while this screen is open.
    CustomContainerScreen.ScreenEventListener
    Listener for events inside a MenuKit screen.
    CustomMenu
    A complete custom menu from one define(...).register() chain.
    CustomMenu.Builder
    Configures the menu.
    CustomMenu.HandlerFactory
    Builds the menu's CustomContainerMenu.
    Decl<V>
    A behavior declaration at one specificity level (per slot, per group and so on): Decl.Set: this level declares a value, and the cascade stops here and uses it, an explicit off such as Set(TriBool.FALSE) included. Decl.Inherit: this level defers, and the cascade falls through to the next level down.
    Decl.Inherit<V>
    Explicit deferral; the cascade falls through to the next level.
    Decl.Set<V>
    An explicit declared value; the cascade stops here.
    Declarations
    Declarations freeze; state does not.
    Divider
    A line between sections of a panel: a solid fill, no texture, no input.
    Divider.Builder
     
    Dropdown<T>
    A single-selection dropdown: a trigger showing the current choice, and a popover list to pick another from.
    Dropdown.Builder<T>
     
    DropdownMulti<T>
    A multi-selection dropdown: a trigger summarising the chosen set, and a popover list where each row toggles its item.
    DropdownMulti.Builder<T>
     
    DropRule
    What happens to a player-scoped slot's content on death, set per attachment.
    ElementConstants
    The colours and spacings MenuKit's elements share.
    ElementHandle
    A typed handle on a panel element (label, button, outline), a created thing that is not a slot.
    ElementSpec
    An element whose position a layout helper (Row, Column) computes: its size now, the element itself when ElementSpec.at(int, int) is called with the computed position.
    EphemeralStorage
    In-memory storage that is never saved.
    Flow
    A run of elements laid out left to right at the panel's runtime width, wrapping onto new rows when it runs out of room: the runtime row.
    Flow.Builder
     
    Focus
    Focus for widgets MenuKit places on a screen, and the "is this point covered by MenuKit" checks.
    GatingContext
    The context a SlotGate decision runs in: who is acting.
    GroupKey
    A bulk-addressing group: a stable id plus a membership predicate over Addresses.
    HudIcon
    A HUD element that draws a sprite from the GUI atlas at a given size, using vanilla's blitSprite.
    HudNotification
    A timed HUD popup that slides in, stays for a while, then fades out.
    HudNotification.Builder
     
    HudNotification.SlideDirection
    Direction the notification slides in from.
    HudPanel
    Builds HUD panels: panels drawn on the game's heads-up display.
    HudPanel.BarBuilder
    Configures a progress bar element.
    HudPanel.Builder
     
    HudPanel.ItemBuilder
    Configures an item display element.
    HudPanel.SlotBuilder
    Configures a HUD slot element.
    HudPanel.TextBuilder
    Configures a text element.
    HudSlot
    A HUD element that draws an item in a hotbar slot.
    Icon
    A sprite at a fixed size: the "show a picture" primitive.
    Icon.Builder
     
    InfoBox
    A block of text on a raised background: an explanation or a notice inside a panel.
    InfoBox.Builder
     
    InputContext
    Input-time context passed to every PanelElement input method, the input twin of RenderContext: where the element's containing content origin is on screen, where the mouse is, and whether the element's surroundings are disabled.
    InsideRegion
    A region on a reference rectangle: one of nine spots, the four corners, the four edge midpoints, and the centre, inset from the edge.
    ItemDisplay
    An item drawn at a fixed size, with its count and durability bar, and optionally a coloured outline.
    ItemDisplay.Builder
     
    ItemPicker
    A setting whose value is an item: a slot showing the item the setting is about, and a lens onto it.
    ItemPicker.Builder
     
    KeyedStorage
    A Storage that knows its own persistent identity.
    KeyedStorages
    Factories for KeyedStorage, a Storage that declares its own PersistentContainerKey so per-slot state persists for registered slots.
    KindTag
    What kind of addressable thing an Address names.
    MendingCandidates
    Lets a consumer add extra items to the XP repair pool, beyond the registered slots opted in by address through ContainerKeys.MENDING.
    MendingCandidates.Candidate
    One mendable item plus how to persist its repair.
    MendingCandidates.Provider
    Supplies a player's extra mend candidates when an XP orb is collected.
    MenuPanel
    A panel as a menu knows it on both sides: its id and whether its slots are shown.
    MenuScreenFactory
    Builds the client CustomContainerScreen for a registered CustomMenu.
    MK
    Mod entry point for MenuKit and the process-wide facade for HUD panels, notifications, and the recipe-book query.
    MKScreen
    Base class for standalone screens built with MenuKit: full-screen, client-local, interactive UIs not tied to a container menu.
    MKTooltip
    The one place a hover tooltip is queued: every element tooltip and the panel tooltip go through MKTooltip.queue(GuiGraphicsExtractor, Component, int, int) instead of calling vanilla's setTooltipForNextFrame directly.
    MKTooltip.Placement
    Where MKTooltip.avoidCoverWhen(BooleanSupplier) puts a tooltip: the lines it shows (wrapped or not) and the x its text starts at.
    MKTooltip.Side
    A side of the cursor; VANILLA is "wherever vanilla puts it".
    MKTooltip.Wheel
    Listener for MKTooltip.onWheel(MKTooltip.Wheel).
    OperationProbe
    Lets a test mod check the click-tag hand-off and the in-world actions: which operation a sent click carried, and whether an action would be refused.
    OperationProbe.Tag
    A click tag as the probe sees it: the operation pair it carries.
    OutsideRegion
    A region outside a reference rectangle: pick a side, pick which end to align to, and stack away from that end.
    Panel
    The basic unit of composition.
    Panel.Builder
    Builds a Panel.
    PanelElement
    A visual or interactive element within a Panel.
    PanelHandle
    A typed handle on a panel itself: its own visibility and opacity.
    PanelPosition
    Where a panel sits: the one placement declaration every host reads.
    PanelPosition.Mode
    How a panel is positioned.
    PanelStyle
    Visual style for a panel's background.
    PersistentContainerKey
    Persistent identity for a Container, the owner a slot's state attaches to, in a form that survives session boundaries.
    PersistentContainerKey.BlockEntityKey
    Block-entity-backed container (chest, shulker box, furnace, hopper, etc.).
    PersistentContainerKey.EnderChest
    The player's ender chest (distinct from their main inventory).
    PersistentContainerKey.EntityKey
    Entity-backed container (donkey, llama, mule, minecart-with-chest, etc.).
    PersistentContainerKey.Modded
    Modded container type.
    PersistentContainerKey.PlayerInventory
    The player's main inventory, hotbar, armor, and offhand slots.
    PlayerStorage
    Marks a Storage as the player inventory side of a menu, as opposed to the container side.
    ProgressBar
    A bar filled to a fraction, read every frame: health, progress, a timer.
    ProgressBar.Builder
     
    ProgressBar.Direction
    Which way the fill grows.
    Radio<T>
    One choice of a single-selection set: a square with a dot when its value is the RadioGroup's selection, and a label beside it.
    Radio.Builder<T>
     
    RadioGroup<T>
    The lens a set of Radio buttons shares: which value is selected, read from the consumer every frame and written back when the player picks another.
    ReactCause
    Why a reaction fired.
    ReactEvent
    What a ReactiveHook receives when a slot's contents change.
    ReactiveHook
    A consumer's reaction to a slot's synced contents changing on the client, the value type of the ON_INSERT_OBSERVED/ON_TAKE_OBSERVED behavior keys.
    Reference
    The rectangle a panel is placed against, a reference.
    RegionConstants
    The region layout constants, stacking gaps and edge insets, in one place.
    RenderContext
    Render-time context passed to every PanelElement.render(RenderContext).
    ResolvedSlotGroup
    One slot group as it exists on an open menu: what it is called, what kind of thing it is, and which slots it currently holds.
    Row
    Lays elements out left to right: it positions each child with even spacing and a vertical alignment, and returns a flat list of positioned PanelElements.
    Row.Builder
    Builds one row.
    ScreenKind
    The kind of screen an element is on, which decides how it draws (6.1.0).
    ScreenMatcher
    Which screens a registered slot (or any feature meant for every inventory screen) applies to.
    ScreenOrigin
    Screen-space top-left coordinates of a panel: what a pixel(...) placement supplies each frame, and what a panel host resolves every other placement to (RegionMath.resolveMenu / resolveInside).
    ScreenPanelAdapter
    Puts a Panel on vanilla container screens.
    ScrollContainer
    A clipped viewport over pre-positioned elements, scrolled vertically: the single primitive for "show content larger than its bounds".
    ScrollContainer.Builder
     
    Section
    A collapsible section: a header row that opens and closes the elements under it.
    Section.Builder
     
    Slider<V>
    A slider: vanilla's AbstractSliderButton, laid out and lensed by MenuKit.
    Slider.Builder<V>
     
    SlotElement
    A registered slot shown as a PanelElement.
    SlotElement.Builder
    Builds a SlotElement.
    SlotFlowElement
    Lays out a panel's registered slots to fit its width, the way text and elements size to fit.
    SlotFlowElement.Builder
    Builds a SlotFlowElement over slot elements, in flow order.
    SlotGate
    What a slot accepts and releases, and how much of an item it holds: the value of BehaviorKeys.GATING, the slot author's rule.
    SlotGroup
    A group of slots: their Storage, shift-click priority, right-click handler and layout.
    SlotGroupCategories
    The registry of SlotGroupResolvers, one primary per menu class.
    SlotGroupCategory
     
    SlotGroupId
    Names one slot group, one coherent run of slots sitting in one place on screen.
    SlotGroupId.Category
    The one group a resolver contributes for category on a menu: vanilla's resolvers, and a mod's own resolver for its own menu, name a group this way.
    SlotGroupId.Created
    A group created through MenuKit-Containers, named by its declaration.
    SlotGroupPanelAdapter
    Anchors a Panel to a slot group's box on container screens: a toolbar above the player inventory, a readout beside the hotbar.
    SlotGroupResolver
    Maps one menu class's instances to slot groups by SlotGroupCategory, as slot indices (positions in menu.slots).
    SlotGroups
    Every slot group anyone has declared, with no menu open: the menu-free half of the slot group registry.
    SlotGroups.CreatedGroupLookup
    The created group a live slot belongs to, or null for a slot that is not a created one.
    SlotGroups.Entry
    One row of the player-facing list.
    SlotGroupSet
    A player-facing name for several slot groups that are one thing to the player.
    SlotHandle
    A typed handle on a slot, vanilla or created: the slot verbs, plus the generic WindowHandle.set(BehaviorKey, Decl).
    SlotLayout
    The slot layout of a CustomContainerMenu: which panels it has, which slot groups each holds, and how shift-click pairs them.
    SlotLayout.PanelBuilder
    One panel's slot groups and its server-side flags.
    SlotLayout.PanelSlots
    One declared panel, as built: its id, whether it starts shown, whether a player may toggle it, and its slot groups in order.
    SlotNames
    Display names for slots, on the client: labels like "Hotbar 3", "Chestplate" or "Offhand".
    SlotOperations
    The slot operations vocabulary: the open set of things that can be done to a slot, what each slot lets through, and the one question every operation asks before it acts.
    SlotOperations.AppliesTo
    Which slot groups an operation can act on.
    SlotOperations.GroupVeto
    A SlotOperations.Veto that is handed the slot's group: SlotGroups.of(SlotRef) of the slot, resolved once per question and shared by every group veto, or null when the slot is in no known group.
    SlotOperations.Role
    What an operation does to the slot it acts on.
    SlotOperations.Veto
    A rule that refuses an operation on a slot, laid over the cascade by a mod that is not the slot's author.
    SlotRef
    The slot an operation is about to act on, as much of it as the seam can supply.
    SlotRendering
    The recessed 18×18 slot frame for registered slots that live outside a vanilla container texture, the one piece of a created slot's presentation that is panel chrome rather than the slot itself.
    SlotScreenRect
    A vanilla slot's on-screen item box in absolute screen-space pixels, what VanillaSlotResolver.resolve(AbstractContainerScreen, int) returns.
    SlotSpec
    A side-neutral description of one group of registered slots that a ContainerPanel adds to every container the player opens.
    SlotState
    Entry point for persistent per-slot state.
    SlotStateChannel<T>
    A typed per-slot state channel, the handle consumers use to read and write slot state.
    SlotStateChannel.CanWrite
    Who may write this channel from a client.
    SlotStateChannel.Visibility
    Channel visibility.
    Storage
    Where items live: get, set, size and markDirty.
    StorageAttachment<O,C>
    Where a slot group's contents are saved, by owner type.
    StorageAttachment.PlayerStorageAttachment<C>
    A StorageAttachment with death handling, returned only by the player-anchored factories (StorageAttachment.playerAttached(String, String, int) and StorageAttachment.customPlayerAttached(CustomAttachmentSpec)).
    StorageContainerAdapter
    Adapts a MenuKit Storage to vanilla's Container interface.
    Tabs
    A tab strip and the area below it that shows the selected tab's body.
    Tabs.Align
    Where tabs sit within a row; in Tabs.Mode.SIDEBAR, where the label sits within its tab.
    Tabs.Builder
     
    Tabs.Mode
    How the strip lays out when the tabs don't fit one row.
    Tabs.Tab
    One tab: an id, a label, a body, and whether it shows.
    Tabs.TabSpec
    A tab under construction.
    Text
    Text drawing shared by MenuKit's elements: one line in a bounded width, and wrapped text.
    TextField
    A single-line text field: vanilla's EditBox, laid out and lensed by MenuKit.
    TextField.Builder
     
    TextLabel
    A line of text in a Panel, fixed or read every frame.
    TextLabel.Builder
     
    TextRole
    What a piece of text is for, so the kind of screen decides its colour (6.1.0).
    Tier
    Which authority tier a BehaviorKey belongs to.
    Toggle
    A two-state on/off control: MenuKit's general boolean primitive, a lens onto the consumer's boolean and only a lens.
    Toggle.Builder
     
    TriBool
    The value a Decl.Set carries for a boolean BehaviorKey, so "explicitly off" is a declared value, distinct from "unset" or "inherit".
    VanillaScreenPanelAdapter
    Puts a Panel on vanilla non-container screens: Options, Controls, KeyBinds, world select, the title screen, and any other Screen that is not a container screen.
    VanillaSlotResolver
    Finds where a player-inventory slot is on whatever screen is open.
    VirtualStorage
    Storage backed by a read function and a write function, so a consumer can bring any external data source into MenuKit's Storage interface.
    VisibilityRule
    The value of the VISIBILITY behavior: whether an addressable thing is shown, as a client-side predicate rather than a flag.
    Window
    The entry point to the window: where a consumer gets a typed handle to set or read behavior on anything addressable.
    WindowEngine
    The window's resolution engine: one store, one cascade, one method, WindowEngine.resolve(Address, BehaviorKey).
    WindowHandle
    The base of the window's typed handles: an immutable value that addresses one thing by its Address, never by a live reference.
    WindowSignals
    Which slot the cursor is over (WindowSignals.hovered) and which slot was last clicked (WindowSignals.selected), as Addresses, observed on the client.
    WindowView
    The window's view of one open menu, which mints typed WindowHandles.
